Free music tools

Turn what you sing, hum, play or hear into Tonic Solfa and sheet music. Each tool works in your browser, with 30 seconds free and no account.

  • Tonic Solfa converter Any song or recording written out in solfa, in its key.
  • Hum to sheet music A hummed or sung tune as staff notation and solfa.
  • YouTube to sheet music A song's melody from a link, as sheet music and solfa.
  • Sheet music to Tonic Solfa Staff notation, from a file or played in, rewritten in solfa.
  • Tonic Solfa of worship songs Any praise and worship song in solfa, in your key.
  • Hum to find a hymn Hum a few bars and find which hymn it is.
